note: Modern campground of Yankee Springs Recreation Area (Michigan DNR) set along Gun Lake: a mix of shaded, semi-shaded and open sites near a buoyed swim beach, a boating access site and trails. Two bicycle-camp sites. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + rates table + MiDNRReservations: electric changed 30 -> 50 (39 sites 50-amp on the booking site), no sewer (new), 200 sites (confirmed) to 40 ft (new) with 6 pull-throughs (new), showers/flush toilets/dump (confirmed); fees changed 30/35 (2026 table) -> 30/45 (2027 booking site; $30 is the off-season semi-modern rate); reservable (confirmed) with reservation season Apr 1 - Nov 29 (now manual).
